description: What the app’s merge tests send and read, recorded from the app with writes on generation 5 of fixtures/merge.sh’s pull requests, rozed-dev/e2e#174 to #190, each from a copy of Lo of its own, with each tab open long enough for its polls to repeat before and after: Lo squash-merged #174 with a commit title typed in the panel, merged #175 with a merge commit, and rebased #176 onto its base; and on #183, with its confirmation open, merge.sh 5 --push added a commit just before ⏎ confirmed it, so GitHub took the merge of the head Lo showed and then failed it, as not mergeable, and Lo then read the newer push.
